newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RGC says no major purchase planned.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RGC says no major purchase planned.

text.p: RGC Ltd said on Wednesday it has no plans for any major acquisitions in the near future following the raising of US$150 million through a note issue earlier.
"We have no major acquisitions planned," managing director Mark Bethwaite told reporters after the company's annual meeting. RGC is 40 percent owned by Hanson Plc.
Bethwaite said RGC has currently drawn about US$200 million of its US$525 million in debt facilities. "What we are looking at are more bolt on acquisitions," Bethwaite said.
He said RGC planned to consolidate recent acquisitions before looking at any expansion through corporate moves.
"There is quite a major consolidation job to be done," Bethwaite said. "We are fully occupied on the corporate front," he said. He said he saw the 1996/97 year as a period of consolidation.
RGC ended up with 76.7 percent of Cudgen RZ Ltd after it launched a A$80 million takeover bid for mineral sands group in June.
RGC through its gold arm Goldfields Ltd launched a A$440 million takeover bid for Pancontinental Mining Ltd in February 1995. Goldfields now owns just under 88 percent of Pancontinental.
RGC shares closed 11 cents higher at A$5.50 on Wednesday.
